title: Design: Authorizer list is unchanged when the customer pays for itself
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer B with two authorizer contacts.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B (an Estimate is fine) that bills itself, so its Bill To reads This customer.
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p2-09-before-authorizer-list-s2-17577.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Authorizer field on the customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows "No authorizer" and customer B's contacts, each on one line, with no customer name under them, as in production.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12306 (Story 4, Authorizer list when someone else pays)

  • S4-N1: “When the customer pays for itself, the list is exactly today's, with no second line.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
